source: hand-authored fixture for issues #237/#259 — not shipped data
description: Two entries sharing ONE id and publishing NO substanceName, which is the shape DrugReferenceInjector.matchingEntries groups on its documented getId() fallback. The curated parser drops an entry only for a blank id or name and no DrugReferenceValidity rule reports a duplicate id, so an operator-editable file reaches this. They are one CITABLE entity and NOT a declared substance, so the row-attribution clause must stay silent: 'filed separately for the same substance' would claim something this file never said. Both rows publish a band so the record has content either way, and they differ in name so a clause WOULD have two names to contrast if the guard were missing.
